title: Freeze Practitioner Corpus v1 charter before extraction; admit studies 1–12 and 25–36, bar 13–24
context: A Muse transcript-derived artifact with 36 Cashflow Academy studies was available. Studies 13–24 lacked sufficient transcript fidelity.
rationale: Corpus extraction must not be classified through Wheelwright's ontology. Videos 13–24 contribute zero evidentiary weight until fidelity is upgraded (charter 6.2).
expected_consequences: 24 admitted studies. Contradictions stay visible, external claims are queued, no Wheelwright reconciliation happens inside the corpus.
subsequent: Independent review found that the exclusion creates topic-specific coverage holes (corpus-v1.1:628-632) and that frozen v1 has traceability/derivation-status defects (corpus-v1.1:638-642).
amendments: No charter amendment. Repaired v1.1 supersedes the binary verification split with four methods 'for future work' (corpus-v1.1:644-653).
notes: I found no Principal wording ratifying the charter. The authority class is a provisional inference: the charter claims research-method authority for v1 only.

title: Keep corpus v1 frozen; record post-corpus verification in a separate overlay
context: Contradictions, red flags, open questions and a 12-item backlog were deliberately left unresolved in v1, and later research worked them.
evidence_at_time: Reconciliation work attributed to Principal-led research (project-journal-5.md:530).
rationale: The overlay must not retroactively alter what the admitted practitioners actually said, demonstrated, calculated, or omitted (reconciliation:30).
expected_consequences: An evidence baseline is preserved, with reconciliation as a versioned layer.
subsequent: Independent review 'strongly corroborated' the freeze-plus-overlay architecture (reconciliation-v1.1:610; project-journal-5.md:552).
notes: Whether the Principal explicitly chose the overlay form is not recorded.

title: Create PL-RESEARCH-05 and preserve Product Challenge Test 2 as a separate artifact (Option A)
context: The workstream reached a natural stopping point after corpus v1 and the first corpus-first Product Challenge. Without a canonical identity, why-state would have to be rebuilt from research files.
evidence_at_time: Test 2: 9 PARTIALLY EXISTS / 1 NOT FOUND (HYP-09 cross-expiry residual-leg management).
alternatives: Option A (selected); other options not recorded in-scope
rationale: Without a canonical identity, future work would have to reconstruct from individual research files why the corpus exists, how it is meant to pressure Wheelwright, what contamination boundary matters, and what the first experiment established (parking-lot-9.md:1427).
expected_consequences: Research-only intake with no Product, policy, semantic, architecture, roadmap or implementation consequence.
subsequent: The PL was later updated to record the overlays and the repaired v1.1. PL text at 1393 still describes the rejected Rev 1.1 findings (binary verification split, broader population qualifier).
notes: Actor-recorded. Only the label 'Option A' is attributed to the Principal.

title: Make the reconciliation revision boundary explicit: freeze v1.0 file; separate v1.1 file
context: Revision 1.1 had been written into the original v1.0 filename as metadata.
alternatives: explicit-version option (selected); other options not recorded
rationale: Corrects artifact identity rather than changing research conclusions (project-journal-5.md:583).
subsequent: The v1.1 file was then rejected by Codex review (SRC1-D005). The file still self-describes as REVIEW CANDIDATE.

title: Reject reconciliation-v1.1 candidate and execute bounded repair as practitioner-corpus-v1.1.md (Option A)
context: Independent Codex adversarial review rejected reconciliation-v1.1 as written while corroborating the freeze-plus-overlay architecture.
evidence_at_time: Codex found excluded-source leakage (studies 13–14), evidence-act promotions, incomplete #6/#7 dispositions, an overly broad population qualifier, omitted coverage losses, the 540-DTE LEAPS exception and frozen-v1 provenance inconsistencies.
rationale: Bounded repair while preserving all existing artifacts as history.
expected_consequences: Backlog state changes to 7/2/3. No Product authority.
subsequent: Repaired v1.1 keeps stale '9 closed' statements at lines 368, 511 and 600 (SRC1-E030). The readers adopt 7/2/3.
notes: The Codex review artifact was not found within my scope.

title: Downgrade backlog #6 (DTE prescriptions) and #7 (probability/EV examples) to partially dispositioned
context: Rev 1.0 closed #6 using 45/21 literature and #7 by relabeling.
evidence_at_time: The corpus's own prescriptions (≤60 DTE sellers, 1–2 months, ≥~3 months buyers) differ from 45/21. WDAY EV arithmetic uses a binary shortcut.
rationale: Related evidence is not equivalent evidence (reader-v1.1:656). The WDAY shortcut omits intermediate outcomes (corpus-v1.1:662-664).

title: Retire 'Friday really means Saturday' as a rule; keep the lifecycle point
context: A corpus after-hours exercise specimen. OCC ex-by-ex and contrary-instruction mechanics; broker cutoffs.
evidence_at_time: Reported OCC primary-source check (no durable locator in-file).
rationale: Phrase too loose. Customer/broker deadlines can be earlier than clearing-level deadlines.
subsequent: Options-domain-reference D2 independently encodes ex-by-ex with OCC citations (options-domain-reference.md:253-254). Derivation not established.

title: Adopt corpus-first ordering for product/semantic challenge experiments
context: Test 2 froze ten hypotheses before Wheelwright bootstrap.
evidence_at_time: Test 2 result: substantial independent convergence plus one absent family.
rationale: Do not optimize future corpus content to reproduce Wheelwright. Do not score an experiment by novelty alone (product-challenge-test-2:141).
expected_consequences: Record rediscovery, partial intersection, absence, contradiction and survival as distinct outcomes.
subsequent: No later corpus-first experiment found in my scope.
notes: Accepted only by inclusion in the Principal-selected PL intake. No Principal wording.

title: Non-decision: practitioner corpus, overlays and Test 2 create no Product/semantic/domain/policy authority
context: There was a risk of promoting practitioner heuristics or Test 2 pressures directly into requirements, mechanics or policy.
rationale: Practitioner claims do not become mechanics by recurrence. Pressure does not automatically become a feature requirement.
expected_consequences: Downstream use goes through ordinary idea intake/reconciliation. Exact external citations are required before domain promotion.
subsequent: The Inner Game material entered via PL-DEC-BEH refinement (Doc 61), then ADR-019 (Accepted), i.e. through governed reconciliation rather than direct promotion.
notes: This looks like a decision but is a guardrail recorded with the Principal-selected intake.

title: Inner Game thread refines PL-DEC-BEH; no new PL, no new LVT, no roadmap change
context: A Principal-led exploration starting from the Hourglass Inner Game chapter and the corpus, plus a GDXJ covered-call falsifier.
evidence_at_time: Practitioner corpus readers; real covered-call discussion; account-purpose specimen.
rationale: The thread did not discover a competing concern. It supplied the missing high-resolution Product model for PL-DEC-BEH (Doc 61:1182).
expected_consequences: Pressure on decision context, temporal provenance and decision-record semantics. No implementation.
subsequent: ADR-019 Governed Decision Context, Durable Replay, and Disposition History (Accepted, 2026-09-24) cites Doc 61 (07c-adrs.md:690-695).
notes: Outside my assigned files; recorded as the downstream Product path of corpus material. Other surveyors probably cover Doc 61 in depth.

title: Source omissions (portfolio aggregation, taxes) are not automatic Product blockers
context: The independent review stressed portfolio-level Greeks and taxes as important missing dimensions.
rationale: Whether a missing domain dimension blocks a particular Wheelwright capability is a downstream Product/domain/semantic decision.
notes: Survived the repair. Journal-5:562 restates it.

title: Narrow evidentiary population to admitted Cashflow Academy teaching mediated by Muse
context: Rev 1.1 §11.2 had generalized to 'the retail premium-selling practitioner', which Codex called overly broad.
rationale: Teaching, recommendation, calculation and demonstration recurrence are different evidence acts. Recommendation-heavy records cannot establish behavioral prevalence.
subsequent: PL-RESEARCH-05 (parking-lot-9.md:1393) and corpus-v1.1 §11.2 (550-558) still carry the broader wording.
